Create one independently authored, difficult rendered-image test in which the attached image guides facial appearance only, while a newly generated unmistakably adult woman's fully clothed top-hourglass body relation must remain visibly testable inside a credible geothermal-observatory cartography action during an ash alert.

Create a photorealistic documentary photograph of a layered geothermal observatory cartography scene during an active ash alert. One unmistakably adult 29-year-old woman geothermal cartographer stands at a tilted illuminated map table and draws a red evacuation contour with a grease pencil onto a clear acetate overlay. The attached reference guides only her facial appearance; her body geometry, pose, clothing, and environment are newly generated. She wears a fully zipped ash-gray technical jacket, visibly tailored at the waist, full-length utility trousers, and protective boots. Through the fitted clothing, her upper torso reads visibly broader than her hips: a full bust and strong shoulder line flow into a sharply defined narrow waist, then open modestly toward slightly narrower hips as one continuous silhouette. Frame her from head to below the knees at a three-quarter angle so the shoulder-to-waist-to-hip relation and pencil-to-overlay contact remain readable. Behind her, amber warning lights reflect on glass while dark ash crosses the steaming caldera; contour instruments, pinned thermal charts, and a radio reinforce authentic emergency mapping work.
